text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The annual summer camp has begun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
What one can gain from summer camp
greatly
hinges upon their frame of mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I plan to make the most of this
opportunity and
use my time here
productively.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Me too! "A day at camp is worth two in
class"
really sums it up!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. This is a unique opportunity to
devote
ourselves solely to training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I shall conquer my weaknesses at camp
this year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki is as fired up as her peers.
I'll have
to work hard to ensure she has a
fruitful summer
camp!
